title: UPLOAD CGM and Carbs FROM XDRIP data TO CARELINK
symptom: User wants to upload CGM glucose data and carbs from xDrip to CareLink portal because their doctor uses CareLink and reports are inaccurate without CGM data.
cause: CareLink only supports Guardian sensors as CGM source and not Libre, so it cannot accept Libre data from xDrip.
fix: No direct fix; alternatives suggested: use Nightscout reports, Nightscout reporter PDF, or Tidepool telemedicine system.
evidence_quote: CareLink only supports Guardian sensors as CGM source and not Libre.
